scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance for Research & Development Activities: Assistance to R&D Institutions/ Laboratories set up by the State Government or by Government of India
other_conditions: Institution must be a Research and Development institution recognized by the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) or the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR)
Institution must be established by the Government of Gujarat or the Government of India
Eligible activities include setting up new laboratories and strengthening, modernizing, or upgrading existing facilities
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for establishing new R&D laboratories or modernizing and strengthening existing ones for institutions set up by the Gujarat or Indian government.
